title.zh: 分支测试等价与双模拟

claim.zh: 两个 image-finite 模型在全部有限分支测试上同测，等价于存在关联这两个位置的双模拟。
claim.en: For two image-finite models, agreement on all finite branching tests is equivalent to a bisimulation relating the two positions.

hypotheses.zh: ExplanatoryBranching 的模型、测试与两侧 ImageFinite；既有经典逻辑依赖保留。
hypotheses.en: ExplanatoryBranching models and tests, ImageFinite on both sides, and the recorded classical logical dependencies.

correspondence.zh: 解释声称覆盖这些问题时才适用；没有证明所有测试实际可取得。
correspondence.en: Applies when the explanation covers these questions; it does not establish actual availability of all tests.

detail.zh: 该测试语言不自动表达共同占用；更丰富的共同语言有自己的关系与条件。
detail.en: This test language does not automatically express joint occupation; the richer joint language has its own relations and conditions.

limitations.zh: 该测试语言不自动表达共同占用；更丰富的共同语言有自己的关系与条件。
